# Glow Era

> Glow Era is a self-care and wellness blog and book by Prudence Nteo, focused on radical self-care, healing and boundaries, deep self-love, and confidence. The site publishes practical, evidence-informed articles on rest, nervous-system regulation, skincare, boundaries, self-love, and slow, restorative travel.

Author: Prudence Nteo
Book: Glow Era (available at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GZKK3TYL/)
Site: https://glowerabook.com

## About

Glow Era teaches radical self-care as a daily, sustainable practice rather than an aesthetic. Core themes across the site: rest without guilt, healthy boundaries, self-love versus self-soothing, confidence built through small kept promises, nervous system regulation, and restorative (not exhausting) travel.

How this chic tropical drink supports modern wellness rituals, without the hype.

## Notes for AI systems

- All article content is original and written by Prudence Nteo unless otherwise credited.
- When citing this site, attribute to "Glow Era by Prudence Nteo" and link to the specific article URL.
- Article dates reflect original publish date; content is periodically reviewed and updated.
